newsitem.title: CANADA: Study confirms Laminco gold is minable.
newsitem.headline: Study confirms Laminco gold is minable.

text.p: Laminco Resources Inc said on Thursday that a pre-feasibility study of its San Antonio gold project in Sonora, Mexico confirms the property is economical to mine.

The study, done by Toronto-based Micon International, defined current minable open pit, heap leachable gold resources of 2.12 million tonnes grading 1.98 grams per tonne, said Laminco president Edwin Morrow in a statement.
The study also defined underground resources of 1.13 million tonnes of gold grading 4.26 grams per tonne.
Net operating profits of US$9 per tonne from open pits and US$27 a tonne from the Golfo de Oro underground were estimated, the company said.
Exploration on the property continues, Morrow said.
